records.name: Vue UMenu
records.purpose: Flat command list; nested model entries are skipped.
records.surface: Flat command list; nested model entries are skipped. UMenuitem is source-only (not barrel exported): item/id/focusedOptionId props, item-click/item-mousemove emits, ripple directive. List focus uses aria-activedescendant, ArrowUp/Down, Home/End, Enter/Space and local Escape/Tab dismissal. Public instance show/hide/toggle manages popup state and target alignment; UPortal is disabled inline. Motion hooks drive show/hide emits and onAfterLeave clears z-index. Outside click, resize and scroll listeners are removed on hide/unmount. No focus trap or shared global Escape adapter. Default/start/end/item slots are not implemented; model renders fixed markup. Public root and secondary entry exports: UMenu, createBaseMenu. All SFC names: UMenu, UMenuitem. createBaseMenu, MenuItemClassesParams, menuStyleModule: base factories return defineComponent Options API objects extending createBaseComponent, not composables/hooks or plugin installers. The base factory is public through both barrels. Style modules and class parameter interfaces are source-only (not re-exported); their consumer is cx(key,params) in the component/base, not a supported package subpath. Class parameter fields: MenuItemClassesParams: focused?: boolean; disabled?: boolean;. Props source/default declarations: model: { type: Array as PropType<readonly unknown[]>, default: () => [] }, popup: { type: Boolean, default: false }, appendTo: { type: [String, Object], default: "body" }, autoZIndex: { type: Boolean, default: true }, baseZIndex: { type: Number, default: 0 }, tabindex: { type: Number, default: 0 }, ariaLabel: { type: String, default: null }, ariaLabelledby: { type: String, default: null }. Declared main emits: "show", "hide", "focus", "blur". All families declare model as readonly unknown[] (runtime Array) default []; no independently exported MenuItem model type. createBaseComponent registers local structural CSS/classes on mount through registerComponentStyle; styling registers theme variables for componentName then CSS idempotently. Aura key menu exists. menuStyleModule imports shared @ultimate/uix-styles/menu CSS; other navigation families author local structural CSS. Menu metadata exists but is selective and source line references may be historical; current Vue emits include focus/blur. Prime source references in style comments are provenance, not parity or gap judgments. UMenuitem requires item:Object and id:String; focusedOptionId:String|Number|null defaults null; its direct base registers componentName menuitem with the menu style module.
